grammar_interpretation.default_logprobs: pre-sampling token probabilities; source does not establish these as grammar-filtered conditional A-versus-B probabilities
grammar_interpretation.post_sampling_probs: available, but grammar-first is false and the sampler can apply grammar during fallback/resampling; static source does not establish a stable post-grammar candidate-distribution interpretation for the requested comparison

logprob_capability_audit.reason: S0 is a behavioral copying diagnostic. Ambiguous grammar-filtered probability semantics are not required for its exact outcome categories and must not change its frozen request payload.

request_level_support.generation_effect: not demonstrated from source alone; n_probs records probability data and changes request parameters, so it is not added to S0 without a separate contract decision
request_level_support.logprobs: supported statically: the OAI chat endpoint maps logprobs=true and top_logprobs to n_probs
request_level_support.response_schema: supported statically: non-stream chat responses can return choices[0].logprobs.content with token and top_logprobs entries
